message.content: {"4": {"original": "The Foundation is being asked whether it will establish a policy or set of条件的 to", "rephrased": "The Wikimedia Foundation is currently facing inquiries regarding whether it will create formal policies or specific conditions to restrict future digital protests and advocacy campaigns, even as it acknowledges the value of community-led decision-making processes.", "summary": "The Wikimedia Foundation faces questions about restricting future digital protests despite valuing community decisions."}, "5": {"original": "Wikimedia lacks advocacy experience, so mistakes are likely.", "rephrased": "The Wikimedia Foundation recognizes that its limited experience in political advocacy means the organization is likely to make errors while learning how to effectively support digital rights campaigns, even though it currently has no plans to create binding rules for such activities.", "summary": "The Wikimedia Foundation admits its lack of advocacy experience makes mistakes likely while avoiding formal protest policies."}, "6": {"original": "The Foundation has no plans to develop policy governing protests or advocacy", "rephrased": "The Wikimedia Foundation has no current intention to establish binding policies that would govern future protests or advocacy work, yet it remains committed to creating open forums where diverse stakeholders can share expertise and discuss the complexities of digital rights activism.", "summary": "The Wikimedia Foundation refuses to create binding protest policies but supports open discussions on digital rights."}}
